ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 92% coverage) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters (approx. 8% coverage), resulting in a low global contrast ratio.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-scale, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the central-mid region of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular nicks and significant structural excisions along the trailing edge, notably a large, jagged indentation on the distal margin of the left lobe.
